name: Math tutor
prompt: Review this handwritten math. Identify the problem, show a step-by-step solution, and point out any errors.

name: Vocab capture
prompt: Extract all handwritten words. Define each one and save as a vocabulary note.

name: Sketch critique
prompt: Analyze this sketch. Comment on composition, proportions, and technique. Suggest improvements.

name: Translate this
prompt: Read the handwritten text and translate it to English. If already English, translate to Spanish.

name: Save to Obsidian
prompt: Read the handwriting, transcribe it, and save it as a note.

name: Export diagram
prompt: This is a hand-drawn diagram. Export it as an Excalidraw file preserving the structure.
